S1:12.text: And the earth brought forth grene grene herbe, ſuch as ſeedeth according to his kinde, & tree that beareth fruite, hauing ſeede eche one according to his kinde. And God ſaw that it was good. †

S1:13.text: And there was euening & morning that made the third day. †

S1:14.text: Againe God ſaid: Be there lightes made in the firmament of heauen, to diuide the day & the night, and let them be :: for ſignes & ſeaſons, and dayes and yeares †

S1:17.text: And he ſet them in the firmament of heauen, to ſhine vpon the earth. †

S1:18.text: and to gouerne the day & the night, and to diuide the light & the darkenes. And God ſawe that it was good. †

S1:21.text: And God created huge whales, and al liuing & mouing creature, that the waters brought forth, according to eche ſorte, & al foule according to their kinde. And God ſawe that it was good. †

S1:24.text: God ſaid moreouer: Let the earth bring forth liuing creature, in his kind, cattle, & ſuch as creepe, & beaſtes of the earth according to their kindes: and it was ſo done. †

S1:25.text: And God made the beaſtes of the earth according to their kindes, and cattle, & al that crepeth on the earth in his kind. And God ſaw that it was good, †

S1:27.text: And God created man, to his owne image: to the image of God he created him, male & female he created them. †

S1:4.text: And God ſaw the light that it was good: & he diuided the light from the darkenes. †

S3:28.text: And God bleſſed them, and ſaith: Increaſe and multiplie, & &repleniſh the earth, and ſubdew it, and rule ouer the fiſhes of the ſea, and foules of the ayre, & al liuing creatures, that moue vpon the earth. †
